## What was actually happening

Not attacks, not real traffic — **self-inflicted, and mostly a broken CSP**.

**`/api/security/csp-report` — 4,303.** I loaded bilko.run in a real browser and counted: **26 report POSTs from one homepage load.** Your Content-Security-Policy forbids things the site genuinely loads, so every visitor triggers a burst. 4,303 ÷ 26 ≈ 165 page loads/day — perfectly normal traffic, catastrophically noisy policy. Three gaps:

- `font-src 'self' data:` — but `index.html` loads Inter/Caveat/JetBrains Mono from `fonts.gstatic.com`. **~20 of the 26 were fonts.**
- `connect-src ... https://*.clerk.com` — Clerk's API is CNAME'd to `clerk.bilko.run`, which that wildcard never matches. Every Clerk call violated.
- React's `style={{...}}` inline attributes — a nonce can't cover attributes.

And a deeper bug I hit while checking: **the nonce was never being injected in production at all.** `@fastify/static` serves the SPA shell as a *stream*, and the `onSend` rewrite hook explicitly skipped streams. `curl https://bilko.run/ | grep nonce` came back empty — with `'strict-dynamic'` in `script-src`, that made your own JS bundle a violation on every load.

**`/api/admin/observability` — 2,288.** The admin page polls every 30s with no visibility gating. One tab left open = ~2,880/day. That number *is* one tab, all day.

**`static:social-signals-trader` — 1,904.** This one is fine, leave it. It's 5 files per page load plus the NDJSON live feed — which is already well-behaved (pauses on hidden tab, backs off 15s → 5min when quiet). And it's sibling-repo code anyway.

## Fixed

`server/security-headers.ts` — correct origins, `style-src-attr`, dropped `upgrade-insecure-requests` in report-only mode (browsers ignore it and log an error), nonce injection now buffers HTML streams. Plus defense-in-depth so a future policy mistake can't flood again: hourly dedupe on `(directive, blocked-uri, document-uri)`, per-IP limit 60/min → 10/min.

`src/pages/admin/ObservabilityPage.tsx` — default 30s → **5m**, polling pauses on hidden tab, refreshes immediately on refocus. 30s stays as an option for watching a deploy.

**Verified** against the production build locally: **0 CSP reports** on `/` and on `/projects/social-signals-trader/` (was 26 and 26), nonce present in both documents, Content-Length matches the rewritten body. 303 tests pass.

Expected after deploy: csp-report **4,303 → ~0**, observability **2,288 → ~290/day** worst case.

One thing to note — your CSP is still `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` (`BILKO_CSP_ENFORCE` isn't set). It's been reporting into a void that was 100% false positives, so it was providing no signal. Now that it's clean, flipping `BILKO_CSP_ENFORCE=1` in Render would make it actually enforce. I haven't done that — it's a live behavior change on the production site and worth a deliberate call.
